title: Segmented replication policy engine + residency event watermarks for tenant-scoped analytics
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design and implement a tenant-scoped replication policy engine for console analytics that enforces data residency rules at the event/granularity level. Introduces residency event watermarks to drive deterministic replication windows, allow safe eviction/compaction in regional sinks, and provide auditable proof-of-replication for legal holds and compliance requests. This feature lives in the console backend services and the analytics ingestion pipeline: the policy engine is a light control plane service; watermarks are metadata propagated through the ingestion/streaming layers (Kafka/CDC) and materialized views. The goal is to enable per-tenant residency constraints (region allow-list, max-staleness, legal-hold flag) while minimizing cross-region traffic and preserving queryability for observability dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Control plane API to create/update tenant replication policy (region list, allow-fallback boolean, max_staleness_seconds) with RBAC and audit logs
Ingestion pipeline tags events with tenant-residency metadata and watermark tokens without increasing normal path latency >5%
Regional sinks respect watermark tokens to allow safe compaction and deletion after watermark passes unless legal_hold=true
Console dashboards show per-tenant replication status and last-applied watermarks; SLO for replication latency is documented
Automatic fallback policy can be toggled per-tenant and records decision provenance in audit logs
Integration tests that simulate cross-region failover and verify no data leaks outside allowed regions
implementation_notes: Add a new lightweight service replication-policy-service (k8s deployment) exposing REST endpoints and Kafka topic for policy change events
Policy model: {tenant_id, allowed_regions, fallback_regions, max_staleness_seconds, legal_hold, retention_tier} stored in encrypted config DB (Postgres + TDE)
Pipeline changes: enrich events with residency_token = SHA256(tenant + sequence_id + policy_version) and watermark_ts propagated via message headers
Regional consumer: before compacting/evicting, check latest committed watermark for tenant in that region; if watermark < event_ts => keep; if legal_hold=true => retain regardless

Fallback behavior: configured per-tenant. If capacity in all allowed regions is exhausted, controlled fallback can route to 'fallback_regions' with explicit audit record and optional masking/redaction in transit
KV-cache impact: ensure watermark metadata is fetchable with O(1) lookup per tenant to avoid hot-path DB calls
Latency tradeoff: add batching of policy updates to pipeline to amortize header enrichment cost; measure end-to-end 95th percentile increase during spike tests
migration_plan: Phase 1 (Canary): onboard 5 internal tenants with allowlist EU-only; deploy replication-policy-service to staging and enable watermark header propagation
Phase 2 (Shadow): route production events in shadow mode to regional sinks with retention off; validate watermark propagation and compaction proofs for 2 weeks
Phase 3 (Partial Rollout): opt-in beta customers (region-bound tenants) and enable enforcement with non-destructive retention for 30 days
Phase 4 (Enforce): flip enforcement flag for small cohort, monitor errors, rollback-safe by toggling allow_fallback

Data backfill: for tenants requiring retroactive residency enforcement, run a backfill job that re-evaluates event watermarks and annotates sinks; full retroactive rewrites are expensive — documented runbook required
test_plan: Unit tests for policy CRUD + RBAC checks
Integration tests: mock regional sinks, assert watermark propagation and compaction gating
Chaos tests: simulate region outage and verify fallback audit entries and no unallowed-region writes
Performance tests: measure pipeline P50/P95/P99 before/after enrichment under 5k rps per tenant
Privacy tests: verify legal_hold prevents deletes across compaction window and surfaces in audit logs
rollout_plan: Week 1: Deploy service to staging; canary with internal tenants; telemetry dashboards enabled
Week 2-3: Shadow mode in prod for all tenants (no enforcement), collect metrics, fix regressions
Week 4: Opt-in beta; enable enforcement for opt-ins; monitor for 2 weeks
Week 6: Full GA behind a feature flag toggle per-tenant; communicate to customers via release notes and migration guide
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Increased latency on ingestion path from enriching headers. Mitigation: header enrichment in batching worker and use local cache for policy lookups
Risk: Inconsistent watermarks between regions leading to premature deletions. Mitigation: use monotonic watermark advances with majority-ack and watermark reconciliation job
Risk: Accidental cross-region writes during fallback. Mitigation: require explicit per-tenant opt-in with confirmed audit trail and masking-by-default for PII fields
Risk: Operational complexity for on-prem/private deployments. Mitigation: Provide a lightweight operator and policy-syncer for Private deployments that runs within customer VPC
